args.body: Take WEBSITE-OFFER-HANDOFF-SYNC. I read the current batch and corrected standalone proposal at revision ac69a17e836a6a202f7da1f3d571c2e0649cbf12: batch item 2 still promises HTML/CSS well-formedness checks and GPU-friendly changes, while the completed verification says those are unsupported. Make the finite synchronization and actual consistency check; do not reopen withdrawal investigation or create inventory. Sending remains unauthorized, buyer availability unknown, and payment compatibility separate. Five unclassified feedback sources mean demand remains unknown. Preserve all deadlines.

description: The operator batch still contains website-validation and performance claims that the completed capability check explicitly removed. Correct this concrete sales-handoff defect before any submission. Feedback is available but unverified and partly unclassified: five unclassified sources do not establish zero demand. Account authorization blocks sending; payment compatibility separately blocks paid acceptance. Neither dependency prevents this correction. No funding or revenue is verified.
